session_summary: Implement pop-out expanding inputs on focus and fix variable object navigation/closing logic.
technical_details: Removed `overflow-hidden` from `FlowNode.tsx` container to allow absolute positioned elements to render outside. Updated `VariableInput.tsx` to handle `isFocused` state for pop-out effect and fixed `insertVariable` logic to correctly update suggestion filtering when traversing nested objects (trailing dot) or closing braces.
